If curl also fails, requests differ materially, provenance is unknown, or only a generic 403/HTML page exists, abstain as INDETERMINATE. A later urllib success under equivalent conditions falsifies a persistent client-block claim but not the recorded event. (2) AUTH_FAILURE requires an allowlisted structured proxy/upstream authentication code or an explicit OAuth refresh failure whose layer is known. Bare 401/403, Cloudflare HTML, placeholder rejection, and free-text matching are insufficient. A valid completion with the same effective auth context falsifies the current auth-failure hypothesis. (3) MODEL_NOT_FOUND requires a structured application-layer error naming the exact requested model. Absence from /models, generic 404, HTML, or textual mention is insufficient. A valid completion for that exact model falsifies it. (4) UPSTREAM_OVERLOAD requires a provenance-known application error explicitly marked overloaded/rate-limited/retryable, or repeated consistent 429/5xx observations after transport establishment. One 429/5xx never establishes provider death, and a successful retry should produce SUCCESS plus prior overload evidence rather than erase either. (5) PROXY_UNREACHABLE requires failure before any proxy HTTP response and evidence that the configured target is the Hermes proxy; distinguish DNS, TCP connect, TLS, and local policy failures. An operator cancellation, exhausted global budget, parse hang, or subprocess failure is not automatically TIMEOUT. Do not retry deterministic AUTH_FAILURE or MODEL_NOT_FOUND merely to manufacture plurality; retry only transient classes while budget remains. Historical Hindsight success is corroboration only and cannot satisfy current liveness. (12) Machine JSON should be constructed from an allowlist of typed fields.
